easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Serrated Scorpion by paying {B}.
Repeat.
